messages:
Maria: Heads-up: trying an opt-in 'audit logs' flow for debug traces that keeps PII out. Proposal below, want a quick sync before we bake this into Console.

Akash: High-level?

Maria: Goals: give SRE/devs better per-route debug signals (latency spikes, prompt regressions) without broad raw-body retention. Opt-in at org or route level.

Sophie: Are we using deterministic sampling or event heuristics? also: what counts as PII for this flow? :eyes: 

Maria: Hybrid approach: deterministic sampling by route hash + a tiny ML/regex detector to redact free-text. Persist only hashed tokens for correlation. Example config we prototyped:

```yaml
opt_in_audit:
  enabled: true
  sampling_rate: 0.02  # default 2%
  sampling_mode: route_hash
  redact_mode: token_hash
  retention_days: 30
  fields_exempt: [route_id, customer_tier]
```

Akash: If opt-in uptake is low we'll have blind spots for regressions. Can we force-sample flagged routes?

Maria: Yes — Console will expose a 'force_sample' toggle per-route and a 'boost_window' (e.g., 1h). Also add ephemeral increased sampling via rollout rules when alerts fire.

Lee: GDPR/DSAR question: do we keep any PII that would require deletion? retention policy?

Maria: We never store raw request bodies when opt-in is used. Only hashed tokens and metadata (route, model, latency). Retention default 30d but configurable per customer. DSARs will delete hashes as part of the existing logs deletion API.

Sophie: How reliable is the detector? false positives on code blocks, base64, API keys? we should avoid over-redaction.

Maria: Good point. Detector is conservative: if uncertain, it redacts only candidate spans and leaves surrounding structure intact. We'll add a QA pass and an eval set from internal telemetry.

devex-bot: deploy preview: audit-flow v0.3 deployed to staging — logs routed to staging-audit-bucket (retention=7d) :white_check_mark:

Akash: Cost estimate? even with hashing, increased write/egress could be material.

Maria: Rough calc: at 2% sampling + hashing overhead ~ +6% storage/cost for routes with high token volume. We'll include a per-customer estimator in rollout.

infra-bot: RBAC update: created role 'platform-debug' with read-only access to audit logs. Must be added to teams that need access.

Lee: Can we add an 'always_strip' tag for inbound auth tokens and session cookies so we never accidentally log them?

Maria: Yep — plan to add a default 'always_strip' field list (Authorization, Cookie, set-cookie) and allow orgs to extend.

Sophie: Will run detector against a sample corpus tomorrow and post FP/FN numbers.

Maria: Next steps: I'll open an RFC PR with rollout plan and canary steps. @Sophie validate detector; @Akash add cost telemetry; infra to finalize RBAC and retention UI. Thanks all :thumbsup:
